cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.31.8.0)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0126 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0128 OLD)
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE Fortran)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "")
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS "${CMAKE_Fortran_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
add_definitions([==[-v]==])
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 OLD)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0157 OLD)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/glade/campaign/cesm/cesmdata/cseg/runs/cesm2_0/f.e30_cam6_4_213.FHISTC_LTso.ne30_q_ubc.001/cmaketmp/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-LbvKN4")
add_executable(cmTC_ebd9f)
target_sources(cmTC_ebd9f PRIVATE
  "/glade/u/apps/derecho/25.10/spack/opt/spack/cmake/3.31.8/gcc/12.5.0/jijp/share/cmake-3.31/Modules/CMakeFortranCompilerABI.F90"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_ebd9f_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_ebd9f>)
target_link_libraries(cmTC_ebd9f ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
